jobs.title: Security Specialist/HARPS Guard I - PT On Call Floater hours
jobs.description:
Position: PART-TIME PT Floater hours


SCHEDULE: on-call floater hours


Specific Tasks. The following tasks are general duties for the HARPS personnel. Contracting Personnel (CP) providing service at JBSA-Lackland and Randolph, AFB shall perform the following tasks below;

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS: • Monitor all electromagnetic door locks, door contact switches, duress alarms and answer all telephone calls within the HARPS/Information Desk Control Area. This area is defined as the Closed Circuit Television (CCTV) room, and the adjacent administrative area commonly referred to as the Information Desk. • Personnel will monitor the Identipass, Genetech, and Premisys access control systems. • Initial training for these systems will be provided by a company representative of which the system is being provided by. The contractor will then be responsible to train any new CP thereafter. • The government will phase out any of the systems that will eventually no longer be in use. • Operate, observe and evaluate CCTVs within the HARPS/Information Desk Control Area. • Use the Government provided radio system to notify the Facility Management staff and/or the base installation Security Forces on any alarm or police response situations. • Monitor operations and status of overall security network for the MTF from the centralized console. • Operate HARPS/Information Desk intercom system master station at the console to communicate with entry/exit points or incident locations. • Utilize overhead paging system to notify personnel of emergency codes and alarms. Communicate all information in a clear and concise manner. • Operate video recorder and playback at the request of Facility Management personnel. • Maintain security log and activate control devices for interior and exterior doors. • Receive transfer calls from designated wing agencies and take messages or forward calls to appropriate agencies. • Report and initiate an action report log on any emergency situation and provide comprehensive information to responding agencies and Facility Management staff when appropriate. • Maintain up to date roster of on-call and emergency contact personnel for required areas. • The CP report to an appropriate authority (DCS Supervisors, Security Forces, and Facility Managers) any information or circumstances, which may pose a threat to the security of DoD personnel, contractor personnel, resources, and classified or unclassified defense information. • Maintain Chronology of Events, Access Control logs and Alarm Reports at all times. Event logs will be documented in a professional manner utilizing appropriate grammar and punctuation and include all pertinent information covering the parameters of “Who, What, When, and Where.” Event logs will be sent to Facility Management on a daily basis no later than 0800 hrs. These documents are for official use only. • CP shall perform and document physical checks of assigned buildings, rooms and areas when electronic systems are degraded. This includes manual fire watch procedures when fire alarm systems are down and checks of controlled areas such as pharmacies when Intrution Detection Systems (IDS) are degraded. • Act as the information focal point for all medical groups' personnel, patients and visitors on all resource protection activities and the liaison on these issues to the facility management office.


Qualifications.

  1. Have 12 months of experience as an alarm monitor or dispatcher, either in the military or civilian sector, within the last 3 years.
  2. Skills and Knowledge. Must be able to use, at minimum, Access Control System, Genetech, and Microsoft Programs such as Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  3. Shall be capable of sitting for an extended period of time during the course of their 8-hour shift, but are able to get up and move about within the area. CP shall be capable of bending, reaching, and lifting a minimum of 30 pounds to move and retrieve records or equipment, and may require prolonged walking and or standing.
  4. Personnel must be able to communicate in a clear and concise manner and demonstrate a calm demeanor during high-stress situations

jobs.title: Mobile Patrol Security Officer-nights & multiple stops
jobs.description:
About us

We are a local security company looking for loyal and committed workers to serve our clients all around the San Antonio and surrounding areas. *We have immediate positions for hire* and pay weekly! Serious applicants only please who are willing to work night shifts and use their own vehicle.

IMMEDIATE HIRE FOR QUALIFIED Serious APPLICANTS

Must have current and valid drivers license.

Reliable personal vehicle to use during shift.

Level 2 or 3 Commission card in hand.

Must have own weapon and gear if level 3.

Additional pay per mileage

Contract Work

Work Location:

  • On the road
  • Multi sites

We are seeking licensed Security Guards to become an integral part of our team. The selected individuals will patrol and secure assigned multiple premises (multifamily homes) as well as identify risks to staff and patrons. Full and part time opportunities available. Must be available to work all shifts and have own proper transportation.

Responsibilities:

  • Monitor multiple premises to prevent theft, violence, or infractions of rules
  • Makes periodic tours of entry/exits, buildings and grounds of assigned client site
  • Thoroughly examine doors, windows, and gates to ensure proper function and security; if not, takes appropriate action if needed
  • Warn violators of premise rules and regulations within guidelines
  • Report any facility issues such as fire hazards and leaking water pipes
  • Request emergency personnel for high risk situations

​Qualifications:

  • Previous experience in security, law enforcement, or other related fields
  • Ability to accurately key information into data system
  • Ability to work weekends, holidays, shift work, and extended hours (reliable)
  • Performs administrative duties (e.g., guard post reports, daily activity reports, and associated documentation)
  • Maintains safety awareness; reports incidents / violations
  • Familiarity with security equipment
  • Ability to handle physical workload
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to remain calm in emergency situations
  • Use personal vehicle

Uniform:

Shirt will be provided, must have black pants, belts and shoes.

- Note: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Worker may perform other related duties as negotiated to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.

Job Types: Full-time, Part-time, Contract

Pay: $17.00 - $19.00 per hour

Benefits:

  • Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Facility Security Officer
jobs.description:
Software Tech Enterprises (STE) is an Information Technology Consulting firm headquartered in Frankfort, IL. STE supports commercial and government clients and provides services in IT Integrated Solutions, Software Development, Cloud Implementation Services, Artifactual Intelligent, Data Analytics, Project Management and other IT services. Our mission is to build value for our customers through optimum information technology methods, strategies, innovations and solutions.


Job Description


Role Description: The Facility Security Officer (FSO) will provide onsite support for all security actions in accordance with NISPOM and other Federal government security regulations. The FSO will serve as a liaison with US government counterparts, conduct security briefings and debriefings, monitor classified controlled areas, and perform periodic self-inspections.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Perform all security operations including personnel clearance processing, tracking, education, reporting, debriefs and any other duties administratively.
  • Process necessary badges, visit requests and certifications for government facilities.
  • Daily use of personnel clearance data systems – DISS/NBIS and E-qip and other security software in the performance of assigned duties. 
  • Prepare, issue and maintain DD254s. 
  • Maintain classified materials receipt, logging, control, and dissemination. 
  • Maintain accountability of classified government-furnished information and equipment.
  • Participate in and perform inspections and audits. 
  • Maintain certification and accreditation of the facilities eligibility as well as personnel.
  • Create and update security plans, procedures, and instructions.
  • Develop and administer a comprehensive education training program.
  • Maintain and coordinate excellent working relationships with government agencies.
  • Assure compliance with all government and company security regulations.
  • This position requires U.S. Security Clearance.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • Oversee all duties assigned to the Security Clerk front desk for all locations.

CORE COMPETENCIES

  • Focus on Results - Able to plan and organize work to achieve goals; achieves targeted results with minimal supervision; is accountable for own actions
  • Communications - Possess excellent verbal & written communications skills; Provides timely, well-organized verbal & written information that is audience appropriate; listens attentively to others and retains/processes information.
  • Teamwork - Builds alliances, partnerships & collaboration with others including those different from him/her; deals tactfully with others; assumes helps with a variety of team roles.
  • Strategic Planning & Decision-Making - Develops strategic short- & long-term plans; arranges priorities, distinguishing urgent, important and unimportant in order to meet goals & deadlines; consult & collaborates with appropriate individuals.


Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.


The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

  • Must possess and maintain an active Top Secret security clearance.
  • Must have experience implementing NISPOM requirements


EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE


REQUIRED: 

  • This position requires a BA or BS degree and at least 5 years of experience with industrial security, NISPOM, COMSEC programs, clearance processing, document control, and physical security; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Successful completion of the following CDSE courses: Essentials of Industrial Security Management, Protecting Secret and Classified Documents, FSO Program Management, NSA COMSEC Custodian Academy, FSO Program Management for Possessing Facilities.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:

  • Minimum of five years of experience in the U.S. Government, DoD, Intelligence, or contractor community in security management.
  • Minimum of five years of experience in Industrial Security with associated training and credentials. 
  • Experience as a Facility Security Officer (FSO) preferred. 
  • Familiarity with NISPOM and DCID guidance documents.
  • Significant experience with DCSA Defense Information Security System (DISS)
  • Proficient with Microsoft applications. 
  • Excellent interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills.


PHYSICAL DEMANDS/WORK ENVIRONMENT 

  • The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be regularly required to sit, stand, bend, reach and move about the facility. 
  • The environmental characteristic for this position is an office setting. Candidates should be able to adapt to a traditional business environment.


Primary Location

Washington, DC / Frankfort, IL / Remote


Schedule: Part-Time


STE is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Meet HII’s Mission Technologies Division

Our team of more than 7,000 professionals worldwide delivers all-domain expertise and advanced technologies in service of mission partners across the globe. Mission Technologies is leading the next evolution of national defense – the data evolution - by accelerating a breadth of national security solutions for government and commercial customers. Our capabilities range from C5ISR, AI and Big Data, cyber operations and synthetic training environments to fleet sustainment, environmental remediation and the largest family of unmanned underwater vehicles in every class. Find the role that’s right for you. Apply today. We look forward to meeting you.

To learn more about Mission Technologies, click here for a short video: https://vimeo.com/732533072

Leadership Mindset at HII – Mission Technologies

Role

Leadership at HII is a mindset, not a title. Through our Leadership Capability Framework, we define how every employee grows, leads, and contributes—regardless of role. It sets the standard for how you can develop yourself and what you can expect from leaders across our organization. We look for candidates who want to grow in alignment with these capabilities:

  • Know & Grow Your People – Commit to learning and supporting team success.
  • Build Relationships – Communicate openly, collaborate well, and build trust.
  • Take Ownership – Deliver on commitments and take pride in your work.
  • Customer First – Focus on the mission and those we serve.
  • Shape the Future – Bring ideas, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
  • Act with Urgency – Take initiative and follow through with purpose.

These capabilities guide how all employees contribute to our shared success across Mission Technologies.

Job Description

HII Mission Technologies is looking for an experienced Facility Manager with Facility Security Office experience. The Ideal candidate will possess mid-level working experience in functional areas such as facility/property management and security officer duties. The individual will be responsible for performing all disciplines within facility maintenance, and security to include personnel security, physical security, document control, visitor control, as well as the protection and tracking of proprietary computing equipment.

The ideal candidate will also be responsible for the opening, closing, and daily management of a 5,000 – 10,000 square foot commercial facility to include managing all logistics management operations within the facility.

The applicant must have a working knowledge and experience with the below responsibilities:

Essential Job Responsibilities

Facility Security Officer Duties:

  • The successful candidate will manage all disciplines of security to include personnel and physical security, document control, visitor control, security education and training, and other duties as directed.
  • Will work closely with program CPSO’s to ensure that program personnel are processed accordingly for special accesses.
  • Will be responsible for the administration and coordination of DOD and other Industrial Security Programs and activities to ensure compliance with government and company security policies and procedures.
  • Will develop and administer security programs and procedures for classified or proprietary materials, documents, and equipment in coordination with government agencies and management personnel.
  • Have in-depth working knowledge to implement and enforce 32-CFR Part 117 and SEAD 3 Reporting Requirements.
  • Reviews and implements federal security regulations that apply to company operations.
  • Obtains rulings, approvals, interpretations, and acceptable deviations for compliance with regulations from government agencies.
  • Prepares manuals outlining regulations such as SOPs, SPPs, ITPs, EAPs and OPSEC.
  • Establishes procedures for record keeping, handling, storing, and for granting personnel and visitor access to restricted records and materials.
  • Prepares and conducts security education classes, incoming/outgoing facility inspections, and security audits.
  • Investigates security violations and prepares reports specifying preventive action to be taken.
  • Ensures individuals stay within scope for current investigations and perform the necessary actions for initial and/or reinvestigation actions and track accordingly to internal processes and procedures.
  • Conducts security self-inspections, physical security surveys, and threat/vulnerability assessments.
  • Ensures accuracy of the security clearance data base and document control using the Access Commander database.
  • Interfaces with government customers on security related issues.
  • Ensures that classified information entrusted to the company is properly safeguarded as outlined in federal controlling instructions.
  • Responsible for preparation, management, and interfacing with the Defense Counterintelligence Security Agency (DCSA) during audits.
  • Thorough knowledge of using/applying US Government online programs such as the National Background Investigation Services (NBIS), eAPP (Electronic Application), Defense Information System for Security (DISS) and the National Industrial Security System (NISS).

Facility and Logistics Management

  • Oversee daily facility operations for a 5,000–10,000 square foot commercial site.
  • Coordinate maintenance and manage vendor contracts for janitorial, HVAC, electrical, and security systems.
  • Develop and monitor facility budgets, track expenditures, and maintain inventory.
  • Ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and ADA regulations, including NFPA and OSHA standards.
  • Plan and execute facility projects, including renovations and space planning.
  • Manage logistics operations, including shipping, receiving, and other support services.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for facility-related issues, including utilities, waste disposal, and emergency response.

Minimum Qualifications

6 years relevant experience with Bachelors in related field; 4 years relevant experience with Masters in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 10 years relevant experience.

  • Full knowledge and understanding of Industrial Security practices.
  • Must be able to independently demonstrate the skills and abilities to perform complex professional tasks.
  • Thorough knowledge of 32-CFR, Part 117, ICDs, NFPA, OSHA, ADA, and other DoD facility compliance requirements.
  • Candidate must work well in a team environment and possess excellent speaking, writing, organizational, customer service, interpersonal, and project management skills.

jobs.title: Security Officer with Active Clearance Unarmed Patrol
jobs.description:
Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Officer with Active Clearance Unarmed Patrol in San Antonio, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Shelter, and more. Join a leading team where flexibility meets opportunity. As a Part-Time Security Officer, you can build a schedule that works for you and explore new roles using our Claim a Shift platform. Learn more: aus.com/earnmore. As an Unarmed Security Officer at a shelter location, you will monitor and patrol assigned areas, maintain a visible presence to help deter security-related incidents, and support access control and badge procedures. You will provide exceptional customer service and clear communication while using technology to document activities. Join Allied Universal’s agile, reliable team, where a caring culture, teamwork, innovation, and integrity put people first.

Position Type: Part Time

 Pay Rate: $26.79 / Hour

Job Schedule

DayTimeFri11:59 PM - 08:00 AMSat08:00 PM - 08:00 AM

What You'll Do

  • Provide customer service to residents, visitors, and staff by carrying out security-related procedures, site-specific policies, and, when appropriate, emergency response activities.
  • Respond to incidents, resident concerns, and critical situations in a calm, professional, problem-solving manner.
  • Conduct regular and random unarmed patrols throughout the shelter location, including common areas, entrances, and perimeter areas, while reporting unusual conditions.
  • Monitor access points and visitor activity in accordance with site procedures, helping to deter unauthorized entry and disruptive behavior.
  • Prepare clear, accurate reports of incidents, observations, and actions taken, and communicate relevant information to site leadership and Allied Universal management.

Minimum Requirements

  • Possess an active DoD Secret Clearance.
  • Ability to lift up to 20 pounds is preferred.
  • Customer service experience is preferred.
  • Comfort using a computer or tablet is preferred.
  • Access control/badge experience is preferred.
